description: A single-panel table (Table 1) rendered as an image, captioned "Chemical composition of the investigated alloys (wt%)." The table consists of a header row reading C, Mn, Al, P, S, Fe and one data row reading 0.15, 7.35, 6.00, < 0.005, 0.01, Bal. There are no vertical gridlines; one thick horizontal rule separates header from data. No sample identifiers, no units row inside the image, and no second alloy row despite the plural "alloys" in the caption. The table therefore documents one low-density Fe-based composition: 0.15 wt% C, 7.35 wt% Mn, 6.00 wt% Al, 0.01 wt% S, P below 0.005 wt%, balance Fe. The citing text refers to the material as Fe-8Mn-6Al-0.2C low density steel, so the alloy designation used in the paper is rounded relative to the exact table values (7.35 Mn, 6.00 Al, 0.15 C). The figure supplies composition only; all processing and property information (vacuum induction casting, 1150 °C/2 h, hot forging to 35 × 70 × 100 mm, homogenisation at 1200 °C/2 h, hot rolling to 3 mm in 6 passes at 1150–850 °C, quench to 550 °C, solution treatment at 700–1000 °C/1 h, labels H70–H100, tensile strength 846 MPa, elongation 32%, density 6.95 g/cm³) comes from the caption and citing sentences, not from the pixels.

subfigures.description: Two-row, six-column chemical composition table in wt%. Header: C, Mn, Al, P, S, Fe. Data row: 0.15, 7.35, 6.00, < 0.005, 0.01, Bal. One horizontal rule below the header; no sample names or additional rows.

observations.observation: The table header lists the elements in the order C, Mn, Al, P, S, Fe.
The printed data row is 0.15 (C), 7.35 (Mn), 6.00 (Al), < 0.005 (P), 0.01 (S), Bal. (Fe).
Phosphorus is reported as a limit (< 0.005) rather than a measured value, and Fe is given as Bal. (balance).
Only one composition row is present in the image; no sample or alloy identifier is printed in the table itself.
The caption states the table gives the chemical composition of the investigated alloys in wt%.
The citing text states the steel was cast in a vacuum induction furnace, heated at 1150 °C for 2 h, hot forged to rods of 35 mm × 70 mm × 100 mm and air cooled to room temperature.
The citing text states the ingot was homogenised at 1200 °C for 2 h and hot rolled to 3 mm sheet in 6 passes with start and finish rolling temperatures of 1150 °C and 850 °C.
The citing text states the hot-rolled steel was water quenched to 550 °C, air cooled, then solution treated at 700–1000 °C for 1 h with water quenching.
The citing text defines the specimen designations H70, H80, H90 and H100 for the 700, 800, 900 and 1000 °C solution treatments, respectively.
The citing text states tensile specimens had a gauge width of 12.5 mm and gauge length of 50 mm, machined along the longitudinal direction.
The citing text states the density of the present steel is about 6.95 g/cm³, about 11% lower than pure Fe.
The abstract names the material Fe-8Mn-6Al-0.2C low density steel, which is a rounded designation relative to the exact table values 7.35 wt% Mn, 6.00 wt% Al and 0.15 wt% C.

The abstract reports the 900 °C/1 h solution-treated steel as a ferrite plus ~30% austenite duplex microstructure with tensile strength 846 MPa and total elongation 32%; none of these values appears in the table image.
